description: Message contracts for Quin's SQL flow. Agents emit strict JSON (fenced ```json blocks are stripped by callers before json.loads). Schema is introspected live from the DB unless SQL_METADATA is set.

flow_input_contract.description: What Quin expects when entered. Standalone get_answer() takes a plain question string; QuinChainRunner.run accepts the orchestrator-friendly fields below.

analysis_type.description: Optional; echoed in runner output for pipeline compatibility. Defaults to SQL-based.

updated_question.description: When present, used as the question instead of initial_question.

flow_output_contract.description: What Quin hands back once Insight_Generator finishes.

sql_query.description: null when no valid query can be formed from the metadata.

Query_Executor.note: No structured output contract — reviews the query, then invokes the db_execute_query tool (registered_for_llm) which Sql_tool executes.

output.description: Raw JSON-records string from db_execute_query, or an 'An error occurred while executing the query: <e>' string on failure.

result.description: Raw execution result echoed for Insight_Generator.

feedback.description: Explanation of the SQL error, for Sql_Generator to act on.

inference.description: One or two sentences of data-driven insight, if any.

name: Quin

sub_agents.name: Sql_Generator
sub_agents.purpose: Generates a valid SQL query from the metadata schema for the given question; returns sql_query: null if the question can't be answered from the schema. On critic feedback, revises the query.

sub_agents.name: Query_Executor
sub_agents.purpose: Briefly confirms the generated SQL looks syntactically reasonable, then hands off to Sql_tool via db_execute_query.

sub_agents.name: Sql_tool
sub_agents.purpose: Executes db_execute_query and returns raw SQL results. No LLM (llm_config=None) — deterministic tool executor.

sub_agents.name: Sql_Execution_Critic
sub_agents.purpose: Reviews execution results/errors; routes back to Sql_Generator with feedback on failure, or forward to Insight_Generator on success.

sub_agents.name: Insight_Generator
sub_agents.purpose: Turns SQL results into a precise natural-language answer plus a short data-driven inference.

tools.name: db_execute_query
tools.description: Runs `query` via `pandas.read_sql(query, engine)` and returns the result set as a JSON records string. Returns an error string (not an exception) on failure or when no query is provided.

handoff_note: user_proxy is owned by the GroupChat in agent.py (standalone) or by the parent orchestrator when QuinChainRunner is used. Quin no longer hands off to Eryl / query_transformer.

external_resources: Azure OpenAI (GPT-4-class chat deployment, GPT4_LLM_MODEL_DEPLOYMENT_NAME or AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT)
SQL database reachable via DATABASE_URL or SQL_SERVER / SQL_DATABASE / SQL_USERNAME / SQL_PASSWORD

statefulness: agent.py builds module-level AssistantAgent instances and a GroupChat at import time (schema is introspected once). Prefer QuinChainRunner.run / get_answer as the public entrypoint for reuse. build_agents() in agent.py returns the live module-level agents for orchestrator compatibility.
